# Handler launcher artwork provenance

Handler's paired dog-and-horse geometric line-art vector is newly drawn for this
project. The angular dog, faceted white markings, and circular framing are informed
by the Houndmaster launcher artwork; the horse profile is original. The source PNG
is not copied into Handler.

- Reference project: [ATAK Houndmaster](https://git.tak.gov/aegorsuch/atak-plugin-houndmaster)
- Reference asset: `app/src/main/res/drawable/ic_launcher.png`
- Reference revision: `752e08c1a5ea40ba320e3f830aca7c3a8c8e911b`
- Reference PNG SHA-256: `a1a43405ba1a9657e9f2f31f8a25961dc0ab121c7306be9d053eb747b0208358`
- Reuse permission: on November 19, 2026, the user explicitly confirmed ownership or
  permission to reuse the Houndmaster dog artwork in Handler.

The upstream README's rights notice is preserved here:

> Unlimited Rights granted to TAK Product Center.

No separate artwork author or public license was identified in the reference PNG or
repository. The confirmed permission is not an assertion of a public license for the
original Houndmaster artwork or a relicensing of it under Handler's code license.
